head.h1: Christmas Catering in Dubai — Menus, Prices and What's Included

opening_paragraph: Christmas catering in Dubai costs from AED 90 per person dropped off and AED 700 to 950 for a chef cooking in your kitchen ; myCHEF arranges both. The full festive feast is cooked, plated and served at your home, villa or venue. MyCHEF turns the day into the roast, the trimmings and a warm kitchen you do not have to stand in, whether it is a family lunch for twelve or a company party for a hundred. You send the date, the guest count and the address; during our published business hours a written, itemised proposal you can read back lands promptly. The chef designs the menu, cooks on site, serves each course and clears away, so the day belongs to your guests instead of the oven.

new_paragraphs: Christmas catering covers the whole day, not just the food: menu design, the chef, service staff, all plating and the full setup and cleanup. One team arrives, roasts and carves fresh in your kitchen, plates to restaurant standard, pours the toast and leaves the space as they found it. Because a private christmas chef cooks on site instead of delivering trays, nothing sits under foil or reheats on the way over — the turkey rests properly, the gravy is made from the roasting tray and the sides come out hot together. As a christmas catering company that runs full christmas catering services, myCHEF handles the parts that usually swallow the host: the timing, the last-minute basting, the washing-up. For a small lunch one chef is enough; larger parties add service staff scaled to the headcount. Every element is confirmed in writing before the day, so there are no surprises when the guests arrive.

new_paragraphs: Chefs travel across the whole city, so the feast comes to you instead of the other way round. Popular locations include Palm Jumeirah and Emirates Hills villas, Dubai Marina and JBR apartments, Downtown and Business Bay penthouses, and Jumeirah and Arabian Ranches family homes. The service also works on yachts and at private venues for hosts who want the setting to be part of the day. Because the chef cooks in your kitchen, christmas home catering runs in your own space with restaurant-standard plating and none of the reheating that comes with delivery. Explore New Year and festive catering options, browse all event catering , or see the full range of catering in Dubai . Wherever you are in the emirate, the plan is the same: a vetted chef, a christmas menu you approve and a day you get to spend at the table.
How much does christmas catering cost in Dubai?

It starts at AED 90 per person for a dropped-off festive spread, AED 120 for a standard christmas buffet and AED 150 for a premium buffet with live carving. A chef cooking and serving on site is AED 700 to 950 per person, and a chef's tasting evening is around AED 1400. Minimums are 10 guests on volume formats, 20 on a full buffet and AED 900 on order value.
How much does a full christmas dinner cost?

For a whole-table figure instead of a per-head one, the set packages are the clearest guide: from AED 1200 for an intimate festive lunch, AED 2400 for a family feast, and AED 3600, AED 4500 or AED 5500 as the guest list and the menu grow. A dropped-off christmas dinner for ten sits at the AED 900 minimum order. Add 5% VAT.
Where can I eat on Christmas Day in Dubai?

The two real options are a restaurant or hotel sitting, or your own table. A sitting is simpler but fixed — set menu, set hour, a drive at both ends. MyCHEF covers the second: the same festive meal cooked in your kitchen, at your timing, in a villa, apartment, yacht or private venue anywhere in Dubai.
Do you deliver christmas dinner, or does a chef have to come?

Both are available. A dropped-off christmas dinner arrives ready to serve from AED 90 per person, with no team on site. A chef cooking in your kitchen is AED 700 to 950 per person and means nothing reheats or sits under foil. The difference in price is the chef and the service team, not the food.
What is included in christmas catering?
Included is menu design, the chef on site, service staff, all plating and the full setup and cleanup. One team covers the day from arrival to the last cleared plate, so you host without working.
How far ahead should I book christmas catering?

As guidance: 72 hours for a standard festive package, 3 to 5 days where live carving or a multi-staff setup is involved, 5 to 7 days for bespoke menus and larger private events, and 7 to 14 days or more for corporate functions. December dates fill first, so earlier is safer. Short lead time on a christmas is worth a message: some partners keep capacity for late requests.
Can you cook christmas dinner at home?
Yes. A private christmas chef cooks in your own kitchen or a villa kitchen, so christmas home catering happens in your space with restaurant-standard plating and no delivery reheating.
Do you cater corporate christmas parties?
Yes. Corporate christmas catering covers office parties and team dinners, from canapé receptions to seated three-course menus, scaled to your headcount across offices and venues in Dubai.
Can the christmas menu handle dietary needs?

Every christmas menu is built to your table, so vegetarian, vegan and halal courses are planned in from the first draft rather than added as an afterthought. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
Which areas of Dubai do you cover?
Chefs travel across Dubai, including Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, Downtown, Emirates Hills, Jumeirah and Business Bay, for homes, villas, yachts and private venues.
For christmas catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

Corporate christmas catering covers the office party and the team dinner, and scales to a canapé reception or a seated three-course menu for staff and clients. MyCHEF arranges christmas catering for events across villas, rooftops, offices and private venues, so whether the guest list is eight or two hundred, the format follows the occasion instead of forcing it into one shape. Set christmas catering packages price the whole table, not the head: from AED 1200 for an intimate lunch, up to AED 2400, AED 3600, AED 4500 and AED 5500 for larger seated events, and a chef's tasting evening is priced around AED 1400. Volume formats need 10 guests, a full buffet 20, and orders start at AED 900 whichever festive format you choose. add_block.new_heading: Where to eat on Christmas Day in Dubai — or host it instead
new_paragraphs: Anyone asking where to eat on christmas day in dubai is choosing between two things: a restaurant or hotel sitting, or their own table. The sitting is the simpler option — book a time, turn up, someone else cooks — and for a small party with no kitchen to spare it is often the right call. What it costs is control: a set menu, a set hour, a drive at both ends and a room shared with strangers. The other option is the one myCHEF is built for, the same festive meal at home, where the timing is yours, the children can leave the table when they have had enough, and nobody is watching the clock for the next sitting. Christmas meals in Dubai do not have to mean a booked table at all.

As for where is the best place to celebrate christmas in dubai, our answer is biased but specific: the best place is the one you do not have to leave at the end of the night. That is a villa in Arabian Ranches or Emirates Hills, a Marina apartment, a Downtown rooftop, a chartered yacht or a private venue hired for the day — chefs cook in all of them, and the menu is planned around what that space can do. A villa kitchen takes a full roast; a yacht galley suits a canapé reception and a plated main; a rooftop wants food that holds its looks in the open air. Tell us the place and the plan is built to it.

On coverage, we are a Dubai operation and prefer to say so plainly. Christmas catering in Abu Dhabi is outside the area we serve as standard. Send the address with your enquiry and we will tell you straight, before you plan anything around it, whether a partner can travel for that date and party size.
